accessibility.focus: Base button/link/input/select/textarea: 3px solid var(--cyan), offset 3px; workspace fallback: 2px; canvas: 3px solid #295a95, offset -5px.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Transitions disabled and smooth scrolling removed when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
accessibility.state: Use labels and aria-current/aria-pressed alongside color.

fullscreen.mapping: Preserves existing drawing ratio. Fills a 16:10 viewport; other aspect ratios retain non-drawable paper-colored bands.
fullscreen.exit: Floating Exit fullscreen; Escape closes tools first then exits. Partial stroke cancelled; committed data retained.

penTablet.padAspectRatio: Normal view fits target ratio. Fullscreen defaults to Fill tablet; Match PC proportions is optional.

pad.mappingTradeoff: Fill tablet uses all coordinates and may stretch relative to the PC. Match PC proportions leaves inactive edges.

fullscreen.exit: Exit fullscreen remains floating; Back to controls is in normal view. Fullscreen/geometry/mapping changes end active pen session; restart explicitly.

image.layer: Behind hint and pen cursor, inside mapped pad.

preview.geometry: Image and pen use the same normalized pad bounds; Fill tablet can stretch both, Match PC proportions preserves the target ratio.
preview.clear: Remove image src and hide it on stop/lifecycle change, invalid or hard-error capture, or freshness expiry. Brief busy/rate-limit retries may retain a recent same-session image until its 1.5-second deadline from request start.

ink.title: DeskWing Ink
ink.entry: Open ink window in main Ink & notes or tray; reuses an existing window.
ink.document: Same authenticated shared scratchpad, not a separate document.
ink.canvasPresentation: Fits the whole client area without distorting the shared drawing; non-drawable paper-colored bands at other ratios.
ink.nativeChrome: Ordinary Windows caption and resizable border remain.

notesOverlay.close: Hide notes, canvas pointerdown, or Escape

nativeVideo.fit: Preserve source aspect ratio, center within black surface, leave unused edges.

groups.name: Windows pen input
groups.behavior: PC enables a selected display/window for pen and live view. An explicit active owner session sends input and requests a bounded JPEG target preview; interruptions stop input and clear the preview.

groups.name: Dedicated PC ink window
groups.behavior: Independent native sizing and ordinary Windows caption/border; shared ink document; canvas fills client area with floating tools and optional notes overlays; close only this view.

groups.name: Second display
groups.behavior: Native H.264 uses explicit Start and 60 Hz/current-tablet Match. JPEG ≤4 fps remains a separately selected compatibility view; target Hz and measured video counters stay distinct.

inkStates.localBackup: Saved on this device · local backup kept
inkStates.fullDocumentReplacement: Revision checked; no automatic merge; one local alternate recovery copy.
inkStates.fullscreenAttention: Amber dot and aria-label on Show tools for offline/conflict/local-save error; open drawer for details.

penInputStates.scope: Pen-only input; no mouse/touch drawing; PC target app owns the resulting document.
penInputStates.telemetry: X/Y and reported pressure describe input, not app delivery.

preview.idle: The live PC view appears after you start a pen session.
preview.slow: The PC view is taking too long. Check the PC connection.
preview.errorTreatment: Retryable busy/rate-limit responses retain a fresh image without opening tools. Stale/hard failures clear it. Hard error reveals fullscreen tools only once per session.
preview.retrying: The PC view is catching up. Retrying shortly…
preview.stale: The PC view is paused while waiting for a fresh frame. Check the PC connection.

dispatch.meaning: Client request scheduling limit, not an end-to-end stroke latency measurement or a guaranteed sample rate.

nativeFullscreen.android: Hides status/navigation bars with transient system-bar swipe behavior; removes WebView insets while enabled. Back/native tools/background restore previous normal UI; no automatic re-entry.
nativeFullscreen.ios: Requests hidden status bar, home-indicator auto-hide, and window-bounds layout. System Home/edge gestures remain; Split View/Stage Manager are not forced to fill the display. Exit/mode exit, resign-active/background, native tools, disconnect/re-pair, navigation/reload, or renderer termination restore safe-area layout.
nativeFullscreen.failure: App-filling canvas remains with visible warning when system bars cannot be hidden.
nativeFullscreen.lifecycle: Native deskwing-fullscreen event carries enabled/reason; disabled event restores the web layout and ends pen input where applicable.
nativeFullscreen.verification: Final candidate 9989c864c1eb3fc3befff0654f7de45dddb26c4b passed 65 Windows suites and 39 unsigned iOS simulator tests. The user previously confirmed corrected Pen tablet image/fullscreen stability on the Xiaomi setup and now confirmed native display motion, counters, and Home/reopen/start. Physical iPad behavior remains unverified.

penPreview.authorization: Same current owner, active lease, enabled target, generation, and geometry; checked before and after capture. No capture merely from opening the workspace.
penPreview.transport: Silent JPEG data URL, one in-flight capture; independent of pen-input requests.
penPreview.windowCapture: Selected client area via PrintWindow; no fallback to desktop cropping.
penPreview.displayCapture: Explicitly selected display, including visible windows.
penPreview.retention: No disk frame storage or saved frame history.
penPreview.failure: Unsupported/protected targets may fail or be blank. No guaranteed visual latency or full-motion playback.
penPreview.verification: The user physically confirmed 'pen tablet is good' and 'Yes, image and fullscreen are stable' after the correction, recorded at checkpoint 3f1e050f99d502a4bbf61e5537984719b0837223. Exact latency, exhaustive edge calibration, and target-app compatibility remain separate.
penPreview.transientBehavior: Retain only a recent same-session image across known busy/rate-limit responses; do not reopen fullscreen tools.
penPreview.hardErrorBehavior: Clear the image and reveal fullscreen tools at most once per session.

android.cutoutHandling: Margins expand to reported safe insets.
counters: Still image (heartbeats excluded from picture counts)
Still image (heartbeats excluded from picture counts)
ios.measurementLimit: Does not measure presented video-frame rate.

secondDisplay.sourceSelection: Only the current owned independent nonoverlapping virtual monitor; never a physical-monitor fallback.

native.transport: Dedicated persistent pinned HTTPS response with owner-bound stream lease.

refreshModes.label: Match tablet
refreshModes.meaning: Rounded reported current refresh, not maximum.

native.androidDecoder: Hardware H.264 with resolution/rate capability check.
native.queue: One capture/encoder worker; bounded writes and backpressure; no growing frame queue.

capture.preferred: DXGI duplication of the exact owned display output
capture.gdiFallback: Persistent GDI capture only at 60 Hz

heartbeat.meaning: Unchanged desktop; retain last image and show Still image. Do not count as a received or rendered video picture.

freshFrameAfterIdle.keyframe: Force an IDR on the first fresh picture after this idle gap.

secondDisplay.lifecycle: Explicit foreground start. Exit/background, disconnection, revoke/share-off, source geometry/rate changes, decoder failure, or shutdown end viewing; no automatic resume.
secondDisplay.stopMeaning: Exit leaves the owned Windows monitor available; Remove extra display removes it.
secondDisplay.retention: No streamed frame files saved to disk.

verification.tabletCapability: ADB reported 120 Hz current and 165 Hz maximum on the user's tablet; capability reading only.
verification.performance: Earlier PC-only capture/encode measured 60.01/118.75 fps at targets 60/120 Hz, excluding network and tablet. Separate bounded physical moving-cursor checks received 59.87–59.88 fps at 60 Hz and 118.72–119.80 fps at Match tablet 120 Hz; the user confirmed smooth viewing. After the metrics fix, decoder-rendered estimates reached 120.10 fps with 120.69/119.83 received fps and zero drops. These are not end-to-end latency or universal-workload guarantees.

pcSideMeasurement.scope: Warm isolated PC capture/encode, animated fixture, owned 165 Hz monitor; excludes network and tablet.
pcSideMeasurement.cleanup: Owned monitor removed; physical monitor topology unchanged.

verification.androidCleanup: Fixed and regression-tested. The installed Android candidate opens without the historical UI-thread TLS-cleanup exception. Exit from 60 Hz and explicit restart at 120 Hz succeeded without a crash; the user also confirmed Home/reopen/start on the final build.

physicalPlayback.workload: Bounded moving-cursor checks on an owned 1280x800 display with a 165 Hz source.
physicalPlayback.staticContent: Still image retained without artificial frames.
physicalPlayback.homeReopenObservation: User confirmed success. A new 60 Hz session advanced render counts; the app stayed alive with no AndroidRuntime error.
physicalPlayback.measurementLimit: Shown rate is a decoder callback estimate, not camera-measured panel cadence.

sharingRevocation.observation: Disabling sharing during live video removed all three DeskWing SurfaceView layers; the app stayed alive with no AndroidRuntime error.

ownedDisplayRemoval.physicalMonitors: Names, positions and sizes matched exactly after removal.
ownedDisplayRemoval.continuedUse: A new owned 1280x800 165 Hz display was recreated with sharing enabled and intentionally remains active.

metricsFix.reason: Freshness compared different clock origins; it now uses the callback's local observation clock while cadence retains render-time intervals.
metricsFix.security: Actual scan retained seven existing Low findings with no new issues.

developmentStatus.historicalAndroidFailure: The earlier UI-thread TLS-cleanup launch crash was fixed; current installed launch and tested lifecycle paths succeed.
developmentStatus.physicalPlaybackScope: Bounded 60/120 Hz motion, corrected decoder FPS estimate, explicit exit/restart, Home/reopen/start, sharing revocation, and owned-display removal/recreation.
remainingLimits: Exhaustive USB/Wi-Fi interruption and load testing
Physical iPad and Apple Pencil behavior
developmentStatus.previousStableMainTransport: Checkpoint 66d20d8 had JPEG compatibility preview only, at most four frames per second.

validationBaseline.scope: Final resumed native-video startup, recovery, lifecycle and metrics-clock correction; original-signer Android build and bounded Xiaomi hardware checks are recorded separately above.

components.css: .ds-key{font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;border:1px solid var(--outline,#354151);background:var(--surface,#1c222b);border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:12px 8px;color:var(--blue,#9ac9f5);min-height:78px;min-width:0;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s ease-out,transform .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out}.ds-key svg{width:clamp(32px,5vw,72px);height:clamp(32px,5vw,72px);max-width:60%;max-height:45%;min-height:22px;flex-shrink:1;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.65;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-key span{color:var(--ink,#f5f7fa);font-size:clamp(13px,1.7vw,25px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;text-align:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;max-height:2.4em;flex-shrink:0}.ds-key:hover{background:var(--surface-high,#252d38)}.ds-key:active{transform:scale(.965);background:#293943}.ds-key:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cyan,#78dce8);outline-offset:3px}.ds-key:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-key{transition:none}}@media(min-width:1051px) and (min-height:651px){.ds-key span{font-size:clamp(16px,1.9vw,29px)}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-key{padding:8px 6px;gap:6px}.ds-key svg{width:32px;height:32px}.ds-key span{font-size:13px}}

narrative.northStar: A working surface beside your PC
narrative.overview:
DeskWing retains the established studio interface: a near-black canvas, slate controls, bundled Manrope, authored line icons, and cyan emphasis. The direction is an extension of the working product. Large, legible controls and stable status positions support touch operation while the PC carries configuration and review.

The interface includes Stream Studio, Computer Copilot, shared Ink & notes, Pen tablet, and Second display. Each task gets a useful working area. The board editor shows the board beside its inspector; shared ink gets a quiet paper canvas; Windows pen input gets a clearly labeled target and session state; secondary Windows content gets an unobstructed view. Connection, local save, sharing, and active input state remain explicit.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, compact studio surfaces with clear boundaries.
One bundled type family and a small functional color vocabulary.
Large tablet controls, visible focus, and labels beside state colors.
Task-specific working areas with recoverable editing and readable status.
Paper appears only as the surface for user-created ink.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Pair connection, warning, selected, and error colors with a label, icon, outline, or explicit pressed/current state. A colored dot alone does not explain a state.

rules.name: The Working Area Rule
rules.body: Do not add elevation, illustration, or card framing that consumes the board, inspector, drawing, or display area without helping the current task.

dos: Do reuse the exact base palette, bundled Manrope, and existing authored icons.
Do keep task controls near the content they affect.
Do show explicit saved, selected, disabled, disconnected, and recovery states.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable labels, reduced motion, and narrow layouts.
Do treat drawings, key images, and shared desktop pixels as user content.
donts: Don't introduce a second visual identity for editor, ink, or recovery screens.
Don't use color as the only explanation of state.
Don't make editor preview keys perform live actions.
Don't hide save failures, draft conflicts, or source availability behind a toast alone.
Don't decorate the canvas with sample ink that could be mistaken for a saved drawing.
Don't visually promise full palm rejection, built-in handwriting recognition, universal drawing-app support, or a guaranteed delivered display frame rate.
